description.value: Full-service private campground on the edge of Golden, BC, a convenient base for day trips into Yoho and Banff National Parks; tenting sites include fire pits and picnic tables, with flush showers and coin laundry open seasonally (Apr 15–Oct 15) — washrooms and office close through winter even though the site stays open.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and provides strong primary evidence. OSM tags (tourism=camp_site, capacity=110, phone, address) are fully consistent with website content. Key confirmations from the website: 6-stall hot showers free for registered guests, coin-operated laundry, free wifi park-wide, water station on site, ice sold at the store, and an online reservations system ('RESERVE NOW'); no mention of hiker/biker-specific sites, cyclist discount, e-bike charging, pump, or basic tools.
concerns: Washrooms and office are closed October 15 to April 15 despite the campground being marketed as year-round; cyclists touring in the off-season should be aware that core facilities (showers, store) are unavailable in winter.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, well-documented campground with tenting sites, hot showers, laundry, free WiFi, and online reservations — strong amenity set for touring cyclists passing through Golden en route to or from the national parks.

wow_evidence: 6-stall hot showers free for registered guests, coin-operated laundry, free wifi park-wide
